priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Multi-worker lifecycle and startup operations

tests.name: RunWorkerTopology_WhenStopped_LogsAndClosesEveryRoute
tests.description: The shared worker process reports route-aware readiness and closes every Worker and Client context after cancellation.
tests.arrange: Two WorkerSpec routes with recording async contexts and a controllable stop event.
tests.act: Run the topology, release the stop event, and capture workflow.worker logs.
tests.assert: Both routes start, topology readiness is logged, every context closes in reverse order, and shutdown logs include domain and task_list without Story Analysis assumptions.

tests.name: StartWorkflowEngine_WithCatalogTopology_RegistersDomainsAndWaitsForRoutes
tests.description: The startup script consumes validated inspect-catalog JSON instead of hard-coded routing constants.
tests.arrange: A catalog inspection result containing multiple routes, repeated domains, and the empty-catalog shape.
tests.act: Inspect the startup script's topology discovery, registration, readiness, and summary behavior.
tests.assert: The script calls inspect-catalog, registers each distinct domain once, checks every domain/task-list route, contains no hard-coded Story Analysis route, and handles zero Workers successfully.

tests.name: RunSingleActivity_WithExplicitRoute_StartsOnSelectedTaskList
tests.description: Diagnostic invocation requires an explicit domain and task list and routes the workflow to that Worker.
tests.arrange: A valid input file, explicit target domain/task-list arguments, and a fake Cadence client.
tests.assert: The client is created for the selected domain and SingleActivityWorkflow starts on the selected task list.

tests.name: RunSingleActivity_WithInvalidSelection_ReturnsClearError
tests.description: An invalid or unsupported Activity selection is rejected before a diagnostic workflow is started.
tests.arrange: Explicit routing arguments, a valid input file, and an invalid Activity name.
tests.assert: The command exits nonzero, names the invalid Activity, and does not create a Cadence client or silently route work.
